description_en: Adds or removes a strategy template to or from My Strategies in Task Center
description_zh: 添加/删除某个策略模版到任务中心-我的策略中
name: ModifySoarStrategySubscribe

parameters.help_en:
The strategy ID.
You can call the [DescribeSoarStrategies](~~DescribeSoarStrategies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略ID。
调用[DescribeSoarStrategies](~~DescribeSoarStrategies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add or remove the strategy template. Valid values:
true: Adds the strategy template to My Strategies.
false: Removes the strategy template from My Strategies
parameters.help_zh:
添加/删除状态。取值：
true：添加到我的策略
false：从我的策略删除
parameters.name: subscribe_status

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
